master:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final app icon artwork for Clyntis, a network proxy and routing application across macOS, Windows and iOS.
Primary request: Design an original pictorial emblem called "Flow Weave": two broad flowing ribbons intertwine into one compact sculptural symbol, expressing network routes crossing, fluid connection, and effortless movement. This must look like a designed pattern, not a letter or a typographic monogram.
Subject design: a graceful woven knot with four soft swept wings, a compact diagonal diamond-like overall silhouette, a small clean central negative space, and a single deliberate over-under crossing. One ribbon is luminous pearl white; the other is pale mint jade, with a slightly cooler aqua edge. The wings curve outward then taper into rounded tips like flowing water; no closed circular rings. Balanced but slightly dynamic, elegant and memorable. Thick substantial forms, no thin lines. Restrained depth separates the two crossing paths.
Backdrop: full-bleed opaque square emerald field, rich project accent #228467, gently lighter jade upper left and deep pine lower right, minimal clean gradient. Fill every corner; no rounded outer corners, border, inset tile or surrounding scene.
Style: highly polished Apple-quality app icon, restrained satin ceramic / frosted mineral surfaces, clean geometry, soft broad highlights, gentle edge bevel, no chrome or excessive shiny plastic. Near-front orthographic view, no scene perspective.
Composition: one centered emblem occupies about 60% of width and height, generous quiet safe area, easy to recognize at 32px; strong simple silhouette. Single square image, 1024px or larger.
Lighting: diffuse top-left studio lighting, softly sculpted depth, tight subtle shadows, calm precision.
Text: absolutely no text or alphabet letters.
Avoid: C, S, X or other letters, monograms, infinity symbol, chain-link symbol, wifi glyph, shield, lock, globe, Apple logo, chevrons, network node dots, stars, extra decorative rings, busy internal texture, neon glow, mockup, presentation sheet, watermark. Emphasize an organic woven pictorial mark rather than a geometric letter.
desktop:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent desktop icon for macOS ICNS and Windows ICO.
Edit target: the attached Clyntis Flow Weave artwork, four sweeping pearl-white and mint-green woven wings on an emerald square.
Primary request: Change ONLY the outer tile shape and surrounding canvas. Preserve the entire interior artwork exactly: same four wings, same woven crossings, same central negative space, same pearl and mint colors and sculpted surfaces, same emerald background gradient. Do not redesign the emblem or add any element.
Composition: front-facing centered Apple-style continuous rounded square tile, occupying 82% of the square canvas width and height. Fit the entire original square artwork within this tile and round only the outside corners. Keep original internal proportions. A transparent margin of approximately 9% on every side. Only very subtle tight ambient shadow directly below the green tile.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha outside the rounded tile; no rendered checkerboard; one icon only; keep emblem and background invariant; no letters, text, devices, mockup, perspective, broad glow, thick rim or extra ornament.
